_comment: Harness-only import map for closeout-capture-probe-harness.ts. It copies supabase/functions/open-brain-mcp/deno.json exactly except zod: the SDK 1.24.3 pinned there declares a peer dependency on zod ^3.25 || ^4 and its zod-compat.js imports zod/v3, which zod 3.24.2 does not export, so a plain `deno run` of the module fails at link time on this machine even though the deployed function runs. zod 3.25.x is backward compatible with 3.24 and the code under test (capture pipeline, mechanical gate, auto-resolve) does not touch zod. Run with: deno run --no-lock --config scripts/loop-closing/closeout-capture-probe.deno.json --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read scripts/loop-closing/closeout-capture-probe-harness.ts
